transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. When can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can do light gardening after 1 week, as long as it’s gentle. Try to avoid heavy lifting or strenuous work for a month.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for the information. My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That's good to know. I'm also experiencing a lot of sensitivity to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Mild light sensitivity can be normal, and things may just seem brighter at first. Wearing sunglasses outside can help.

But if it is significant pain in bright light, or severe light sensitivity, especially if the eye is also red and painful, that is not normal and we may need to check it further.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for the advice. One last question: Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after surgery. It should improve quickly and settle down over time.

If it’s still blurry, or getting more blurry, we may need to check it.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that covers all my questions. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they have. Thank you so much for your assistance!

verdict.label: pass
